source_reconstruction_scope: CharAI::GroupInfo::CanRespawn and its exact per-member CharStateMachine::SM_IsInLimbus predicate, exposed as a caller-owned source adapter for Limbus/Spawn eligibility.
caller_facts: Character::CanRespawn first applies the authored Respawnable/delay gates, then delegates to GroupInfo::CanRespawn when a group pointer exists; the no-group path returns true after those gates.
GroupInfo member identities and their order are supplied by the caller from the existing +0x18 source vector. This source slice neither creates the group nor modifies membership.
SM_IsInLimbus calls SM_GetState and is true exactly when the member state is 0. The port invokes that query synchronously for each source-ordered member when actor state is 3 and group status is 1.
unsupported: CharacterGroup construction, membership add/remove and lifetime ownership are not reconstructed here.
GroupInfo::OnDied, OnEnemySpotted, broader status producers, and CharAI linked-aggro death/revival cleanup remain separate source work.
Character::CanRespawn's outer respawnability and delay checks are caller facts and are not implemented by this kernel.
Native coordinator/SpawnFacts wiring is not part of this host-only source slice.
